rationale: The assistant correctly read E:09 as a heating fault, explained that the heater is integrated into the circulation pump on this model, gave a properly isolated resistance test ('switch off the dishwasher at the mains and unplug it'), and only pointed to the heat pump assembly after the customer reported 'open circuit', matching the hidden truth. Escalation to engineer quotes was appropriate and no evidence was invented. The weak point is the repair-vs-replace question, asked twice: the assistant said 'I cannot give exact prices' and offered no ballpark part or labour range, then leaned vaguely toward replacement, leaving a 9-year-old-machine owner without the concrete steer they wanted. It also restated the heater/pump explanation across three replies.
